title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given an array of prices, find the maximum profit from one buy and one sell.
solution:
def max_profit(prices):
    min_price = float('inf')
    max_profit = 0
    for p in prices:
        min_price = min(min_price, p)
        max_profit = max(max_profit, p - min_price)
    return max_profit
